title: DLMF 4.35 Identities: The square roots assume their principal value on the positive real axis, and are determined by continuity elsewhere.
summary: DLMF 4.35 Identities: The square roots assume their principal value on the positive real axis, and are determined by continuity elsewhere.
body: NIST DLMF section 4.35 (Identities) says: "The square roots assume their principal value on the positive real axis, and are determined by continuity elsewhere." Equation 4.35.11 on the page has alt text "{\cosh}^{2}z-{\sinh}^{2}z=1,". Equation 4.35.12 on the page has alt text "{\operatorname{sech}}^{2}z=1-{\tanh}^{2}z,". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
